auth: email/password + pre-wired Google, Apple, Discord and X OAuth; providers activate when configured in Supabase. Sign-in is required before the app can be explored - a game-tease auth gate replaces the whole app until the visitor signs in or creates an account.
adminCode: configured server-side; not stored in this file
hosting: Vercel-ready static PWA; Supabase is the shared backend
features: Classic mode: fixed-position vertical horde defense
Adventure mode: omnidirectional movement and 8-way aiming
Walk-on intro sequence for Adventure mode
Retro menu system with directional navigation
Dr Mantis body-part minions in Classic stage 2
Procedural sprite rendering for creature parts
Fixed aspect ratio locked to iPhone SE (9:16 portrait / 16:9 landscape)
HUD with map-color-coordinated borders (six unique map color schemes)
Joey Rob positioned above bottom HUD bar, fully visible in gameplay
Black border bars with responsive grid layout for info display
Comic-style boss intro animations with character slide-on effects
Enhanced scene presentation with synchronized character movements
UI locked during boss intro and critical transitions
notes: Phase A: Renamed modes (Classic/Adventure), locked Adventure until Dr Mantis defeat, added admin cheat menu
Phase B: Built retro joystick-navigable pause menu, replaced Dr Mantis stage-2 adds with body-part sprites
Phase C: Adventure mode omnidirectional movement and 8-way aiming, walk-on intro, side-entry zombies
Phase D: Fixed aspect ratio, HUD redesign with map colors, boss intro animations, UI locking during transitions
All movement input updates aim direction in landscape mode (joystick, arrow keys, button directions)
Player sprite rotates to face aim direction; landscape zombies enter from right, breach on left edge
Hardened direct calls with Realtime plus polling signaling fallback and TURN relay fallback
HUD bottom bar: 4 columns (grenades, lives, weapon+ammo, map) with map-specific border colors
Boss intro: enhanced animations with character slide-on effects, scene progression, UI locked during cinematic
Tease phase (3.2s): Joey Rob slides in from left, fades in boss portrait from right, speech bubbles appear
Reveal phase (2.4s): Boss name and title animate in, announcement bubble displayed before combat begins

callSystem.hangup: immediate local termination then async remote signal
callSystem.connectivity: STUN plus TURN relay fallback for restrictive/mobile NATs

arcade.controls: three gameplay buttons: left, right, fire
arcade.admin_skins: all while admin code session is active
arcade.aiming: straight forward only; no auto aim

cheats: FATAMY - skips straight to the Fat Amy boss fight
ELITE - unlocks the Phantom Elite console skin
arcadeFeatures.adminCheatMenu: Menu > Admin tab lists every cheat with a one-tap action button (admin access only)

classic.label: Classic Play
classic.gameplay: Vertical horde defense - Joey Rob fixed on bottom, fires up, zombies advance downward

adventure.label: Adventure Play
adventure.unlock: defeated Dr Mantis in Classic Play or admin access
adventure.gameplay: Omnidirectional movement - Joey Rob walks onto screen from left, free movement and 8-way aiming, zombies enter from right edge, breach on left
